meta.title: Canada DND UXO Legacy Sites
meta.timezone_note: Dates and 'last checked' values are recorded in America/Phoenix (UTC-7) calendar dates unless a source gives another zone.
meta.dataset_name: Unexploded Explosive Ordnance (UXO) Sites in Canada
meta.attribution: Contains information licensed under the Open Government Licence – Canada.
meta.attribution_note: Information Provider: National Defence / His Majesty the King in right of Canada. This tracker is not endorsed by the Government of Canada. Official symbols of the Information Provider are not used.
meta.coordinate_policy: Latitude and longitude are recorded only when the official XLSX or the DND locations page provides them. The English XLSX retrieved on 2026-11-23 has four columns only (Site ID, Site Name, Province, Status) and no coordinates. The official locations table has the same fields (the province column is labelled Coast on that page) and also does not provide coordinates. Coordinates are not guessed or geocoded from place names. Blank coordinate fields mean no official coordinate was published in those sources.
meta.verification_policy: verified: the listed site ID, name, province code, and status were copied from the official English XLSX. partly verified / unverified are reserved if later fields are added from incomplete sources.

status_notes.portfolio_classes: DND states that Canada's portfolio of UXO Legacy Sites is comprised of sites classified as In Assessment, Assessment Complete, Risk Mitigation On-Going, or Closed. The XLSX uses the spelling 'Risk Mitigation Ongoing' (no hyphen).
status_notes.risk_levels: A UXO Risk Assessment, which DND says marks the final stage of a site's assessment, can result in No, Low, Medium, or High UXO Risk. Those per-site risk levels are not published in the XLSX and are not recorded here.
status_notes.closed: DND says sites with no or low UXO risk may be administratively closed, and that administratively closed sites can be re-opened at any time should new information come to light which suggests an unacceptable UXO risk. DND also states that there is no technology available today that guarantees all UXO on a site have been located and removed. 'Closed' in this dataset is DND's published status, not a finding that a site is free of UXO.

meta.coverage_note: The official English XLSX contains 854 unique sites. The DND locations webpage table retrieved on 2026-11-23 listed 853 of those Site IDs and omitted AB900-001 / 0539-X001 (Airdrie - Bombing Range, In Assessment). This dataset uses the complete XLSX. Province codes are kept as published, including EC (22 sites) and WC (23 sites). The locations page labels that column Coast. An official expansion of EC and WC was not retrieved, so those codes are not spelled out here. No Northwest Territories (NT) code appears in the file.
meta.inclusion_rule: Every row in the official English XLSX is included. EMODnet, Scotland, and other non-Canadian inventories are not part of this file.
